quote: quote: "He who has a why to live can bear almost any how."
about:
author: "Friedrich Nietzsche"
what_it_means_to_me: "This quote reminds me that having a meaningful purpose can help me navigate difficult circumstances. When I understand why something matters to me, temporary obstacles become easier to approach with patience and determination. It teaches me that motivation is not always about feeling inspired; sometimes, it comes from remembering the reason I began and the values I want my decisions to reflect."
contributor: Lohendra V S
department: EIE
tags: ["purpose", "meaning", "determination", "perseverance", "philosophy", "resilience"]
